name: v9.0.0
body:
## [v9.0.0](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/releases/tag/v9.0.0)

### Added
- [#577](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/577) - Adding a cute ascii art of Archway for the cli
- [#588](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/588) - Add IBC hooks, bump IBC, allows contracts to query callback fee estimations.
- [#594](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/594) - Add Constantine upgrade handler

### Changed
- [#573](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/573) - Bump cosmos-sdk to v0.50.6 and ibc to v8.2.1
- [#580](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/580) - Bump cosmos-sdk to v0.50.7 and ibc to v8.3.2
- [#583](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/583) - Bump cometbft to v0.38.10
- [#594](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/594) - Bump core packages to latest / relevant versions

### Fixed
- [#569](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/569) - Audit remidiations for x/cwerrors and x/cwica 
- [#566](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/566) - Fixing the localnet script to correctly set gov params post sdk v47
- [#586](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/586) - Applied patches for CWAs CWA-2024-003 and CWA-2024-004
- [#589](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/589) - Patch CWSA-2024-005
- [#594](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/594) - Upgraded wasmd fork with amino jason rendering fix

### Improvements

- [#567](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/567) - Remove redundant params fetching in SaveCallback 
- [#572](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/572) - Using buf 1.31 to push files

## What's Changed
* chore: Post v7.0.0 release maintenance by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/565
* refactor(x/callback): Remove redundant code in SaveCallback by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/567
* fix: audit remediations  by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/569
* ci(proto): automatically publish proto files by @aelesbao in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/571
* fix: Fix the Dockerfile.deprecated which wasnt building by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/570
* fix: Update Swagger doc and config to include CWICA and CWErrors modules by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/568
* ci(proto): use buf 1.31 to push files by @aelesbao in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/572
* fix: fixing the localnet script to correctly set gov params post sdk v47 by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/566
* ci: fix chain upgrade test by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/574
* chore: cosmos-sdk bump to v0.50 by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/573
* chore: prep for v8 alpha release by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/576
* style: Adding a cute ascii art of Archway for the cli by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/577
* chore: bump ibc-go to v8.3.2 by @spoo-bar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/580
* chore: cometbft bump to v0.38.10 by @zanicar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/583
* build: bump wasmvm to 1.5.4 and wasmd fork to 0.50.1 by @aelesbao in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/586
* feat: allow contracts to query estimate fees endpoint, add IBC Hooks module by @fdymylja in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/588
* patch CWSA-2024-005 in main by @fdymylja in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/589
* chore: update changelog for v9.0.0 release by @zanicar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/590
* chore: v9.0.0 selected release candidate by @zanicar in https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/594

- [#549](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/549) by @spoo-bar - Integrating x/cwerrors into x/cwica
- [#550](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/550) by @spoo-bar - Integrating x/cwerrors into x/callback module
- [#551](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/550) by @spoo-bar - Adding ADR-012 for x/cwerrors

- [#557](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/557) by @spoo-bar - Updating the module specs to include module error codes
- [#563](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/563) by @spoo-bar - Bumping cosmos-sdk to v0.47.11

### Improvements

- [#533](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/533) by @fdymylja - Add more x/cwfees tests and adjust the gas limit of the RequestGrant call.

### Changed

- [#505](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/505) by @zanicar - Update release process to account for release candidates on Titus

- [#561](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/561) by @spoo-bar - Updated swagger file for latest release

### Fixed
- [#537](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/537) by @spoo-bar - Fix issue with callback failing when module param is changed
- [#538](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/538) by @spoo-bar - Fixing the interchain test gh workflow failing cuz rc tags were not recognized

- [#552](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/552) by @spoo-bar - Fix issue with x/callback callback error code was not identified correctly when setting cwerrors
- [#559](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/559) by @spoo-bar - Fixing wrong bond denom being considered for x/callback and x/cwerrors fees
- [#562](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/562) by @spoo-bar - Fixing the account from which x/cwerrors subscription fees are deducted
- [#564](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/564) by @spoo-bar - Remediations for x/cwerrors audit

name: v6.0.0
body:
### Added

-   [#431](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/431) by @spoo-bar - Added gh workflow to run IBC conformance tests on PRs
-   [#439](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/439) by @jlehtimaki - Adding containerized localnet
-   [#445](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/445) by @spoo-bar - Adding Archway logo and version number to upgrade logs
-   [#459](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/459) by @zanicar - Add missing ADR references to docs index
-   [#442](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/442) by @spoo-bar - Upgrade cosmos-sdk from v0.45.16 to v0.47.5 and all the other things it depends on
-   [#470](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/470) by @spoo-bar - Bumping x/wasmd to v0.43.0
-   [#507](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/507) by @spoo-bar – Version bump x/wasmd to v0.45.0 and cosmos-sdk to v0.47.6
-   [#502](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/502) by @fdymylja - Improve rewards withdrawal experience by allowing a Metadata owner to set that rewards directly go to the reward address.
-   [#462](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/462) by @fdymylja - adding docs ADR-008 – Improvements on rewards withdrawal experience

### Changed

-   [#457](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/457) by @spoo-bar - Modify the upgrade handlers to pass in all the app keepers instead of just the account keeper
-   [#465](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/465) by @spoo-bar - Change the name of the gh workflow job from `build` to `run-tests` as it runs tests
-   [#507](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/507) by @spoo-bar – Version bump wasmd to v0.45.0 and cosmos-sdk to v0.47.6
-   [#529](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/529) by @spoo-bar – Version bump wasmd to v0.47.6 and cosmos-sdk to v0.47.7
-   [#531](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/531) by @spoo-bar - Bump wasmvm from v1.5.0 to v1.5.1. Ref: [CWA-2023-004](https://github.com/CosmWasm/advisories/blob/main/CWAs/CWA-2023-004.md)
-   [#534](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/534) by @spoo-bar - Bump wasmvm to v1.5.2.

### Deprecated

-   [#439](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/439) by @jlehtimaki - Renaming `debug` image to `dev`
-   [#461](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/461) by @jlehtimaki - Remove titus network deployment

### Fixed

-   [#497](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/497) by @fdymylja - Fix rest endpoints in App
-   [#476](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/476) by @jlehtimaki - Fix amd64 binary compatibility on newer linux OS
-   [#514](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/514) by @spoo-bar - Fix snapshot db being hardcoded from goleveldb to based on config 
-   [#522](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/522) by @spoo-bar - Fix Archway module endpoints not showing up in swagger

### Improvements

-   [#478](https://github.com/archway-network/archway/pull/475) by @fdymylja – moves x/rewards state to use collections for state management.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/archway-network/archway/compare/v4.0.3...v6.0.0
